concat_ms2_spec_from_stats_file

concat_ms2_spec_from_stats_file.Rd

Helper function for concatenate_spectra(). Need not be called separately. Gets auto-invoked once we call concatenate_spectra()

Usage

concat_ms2_spec_from_stats_file(j, stats_file, fl)

Arguments

j

jth feature from the stats file.

stats_file

edited stats file with RT_min and RT_max prefixes added to every sample.

fl

list of sample names.

Value

A list with all spectra concatenated for a particular feature

Examples

# Example usage of the function (need not be called separately)
concat_ms2_spec_from_stats_file(1,stats_file,fl)
#> Error: object 'fl' not found
